claims.statement: Manager value estimation (manager_value.do) decomposes ROA into firm fixed effect (frame_id_numeric) and manager person effect (person_id) via reghdfe with two-way absorb(), using connected components to ensure cross-firm comparability and clipping within-firm skill to [-1,1] log points.

Revenue function estimation (revenue_function.do) estimates 6 reghdfe specifications across 4 outcomes (lnR, lnEBITDA, lnWL, lnM), with base controls (lnK, has_intangible, foreign_owned, state_owned, founder, owner) and rich controls (+ceo_age, ceo_age_sq, ceo_tenure, ceo_tenure_sq), clustering at frame_id_numeric.

The placebo-controlled event study (event_study.do) calls xt2denoise with pre(4)/post(3) windows, z(manager_skill), treatment(actual_ceo), control(placebo_ceo), capturing both naive (e(b_naive)/e(V_naive)) and denoised (e(b)/e(V)) coefficients and constructing derived beta series (dCov/dVar, Cov1/Var1, Cov0/Var0) in a unified dCov frame.

The ATET variant (event_study_atet.do) uses xt2denoise with baseline(atet) to estimate a single collapsed ATET parameter, exports matrix-based output (Var1z, dVarz, dCov, Cov, VarY, Rsq, dRsq, se_naive, dse) to CSV without the industry-year demeaning step.

The variance decomposition script (xt2var.do) implements excess variance methodology manually via iterative fixed-point estimation of eVarY/eVarZ (4 iterations of no-constant OLS on pre-period squared deviations), followed by reghdfe event-time regressions for variance, covariance, and driver variance components with delta-method standard errors.

Monte Carlo simulation (montecarlo.do) generates synthetic panel data with 10,000 CEO changes, AR(1) TFP (rho=0.97), known true ATET (half_normal*sigma_z=0.0798), 9:1 placebo:treated ratio, and excess variance (sigma_epsilon1=0.06 vs 0.05) to validate the event study methodology.

The KSS leave-out MATLAB routines (leave_out_KSS.m, leave_out_COMPLETE.m) perform AKM estimation via PCG on the connected set, compute leverage (Bii) and permutation (Pii) diagonals, and produce bias-corrected variance components (sigma2_psi, sigma_psi_alpha, sigma2_alpha) with optional Johnson-Lindenstrauss approximation.

The Bloom autonomy analysis (bloom_autonomy_analysis.do) tests family-controlled firm autonomy using ppmlhdfe on Bloom et al (2012) replication data, with outcomes (central5, hiring, marketing, product) and fixed effects sets (country-only, country+industry, country+industry+analyst), clustering at firm id.
